{{Top|leg}}
The '''Curovao Bombing''' was a terror attack perpetrated by the [[Revolutionary Edge Brigade]] sometime prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The bombing, which involved the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Kaliyo Djannis]] under her alias "Lisha Tetch," took place in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Curovao]].
